date.source: The general manager's report of 25 January 2010 gives it: "Se celebro el 22 de Enero".

evidence.note: The general manager's report on the pay-per-view: date, place, attendance, theme song, nine title matches with star ratings and the night's surprises.
The recap that opens the next show tells the main event and its winner.

matches.finish: El Juez interfered and took away the win Rabid Y2J was going for on Lashley; Lashley then hit Rabid Y2J with a Tombstone Piledriver on the stairs, and RateDX hit a Canadian Destroyer on Rabid Y2J and covered him.
matches.note: The report lists the YWA Heavyweight Championship match last of nine; the recap in the first AWZ show names this three-man main event and its champion, RateDX.

date.source: The results post of 29 January 2010 is the show's only dated record; the board is a play-by-post one and the post is dated the day it was written.

evidence.note: The first AWZ show after AMANECER: the recap of the AMANECER main event, the champion's challenge, three matches.

matches.finish: X-treme Angel hit a GTS and covered Coke.
The Legend Killer Lashley turned on his partner with a Tombstone Piledriver and left; Rabid Y2J covered El Juez.
RateDX locked on an angle lock and Evan Mysterio gave up; the chairman then hit RateDX from behind with a Leviathan Spine Buster.
matches.note: The main event of the show.

date.source: The results post is dated 6 February 2010; its card was posted on 29 January.

evidence.note: The second AWZ show in full play-by-play, the week before SOBREVIVE.
The card for this show, posted on 29 January.

matches.finish: RateDX made Hanoi Kid give up to an angle lock, kept the hold on after the bell, and later hit a Canadian Destroyer and a Tiger Driver 91.
The Deadman hit a Tombstone Piledriver and covered Coke.
RateDX hit a belly-to-belly superplex from the corner and covered Omega Legend.
matches.note: Billed on the card as RateDX's match against another general manager, and his third match of the night counting the main event.

matches.stipulation: Lucha por el YWA Legend Champion
matches.finish: e HBK y held the ropes to avoid El Juez's headbutt, hit a Sweet Chin Music and covered him to win the title.
matches.note: e HBK y is announced as the first YWA Grand Slam Champion.

matches.stipulation: 6 Man Battle Royal por el YWA Heavyweight Championship
matches.finish: Campero LWO threw out The Deadman, the last other man in the ring, and was named the new YWA Heavyweight Champion.
matches.note: The main event. The chairman's attack on RateDX at ringside cost him his place.

eliminations.note: The chairman got up from the commentary table and clipped his leg, and he fell to ringside; the chairman then hit him with a Leviathan Spine Buster onto the table.

date.source: The results post is dated 22 February 2010.

evidence.note: The AWZ show after SOBREVIVE: the recap of the Royal Rumble, a promo segment setting up YAHOOMANIA II and three matches.

matches.stipulation: YWA Alliance Tag Team Championships Match
matches.finish: Lethal Consequece hit a Suicide Solution on The Deadman and covered him; Ivan G and Lethal Consequece are the new champions.
The Legend Killer Lashley hit a big boot, a military press and a Tombstone Piledriver and covered Dolph Ziggler.
El Rey 3 hit three moonsaults on X-treme Angel and covered him.
matches.note: The main event of the show.

date.source: The results post is dated 9 June 2010; its title calls it the show of the promotion's rebirth.

evidence.note: The reopening show after two months closed: the chairman's explanation, five qualifiers, a backstage attack and the scramble match for the vacant Heavyweight Championship.
The card for the next show, posted the same day.

matches.stipulation: Battle Royal Match clasificatoria al ME
matches.finish: Tijuana Forever and El Aire de Tijuana went over the top rope together at the end; Tijuana Forever hung from the ropes with his feet off the floor and was declared the winner.
matches.note: The winner qualified for the scramble match.

eliminations.note: A baseball slide that hit Steve where he stood on the edge of the ring.
Thrown to ringside by both teammates.
His own crossbody took both men over the top rope; Tijuana Forever held on to the ropes.

matches.finish: Big Evil won with a Shooting Star Press.
Showtime Mr. PPV won with a Five Star Frog Splash.
Lashley had left Omega Legend bleeding and knocked out in the backstage corridors with a fire extinguisher; Omega Legend did not come to the ring and the referee counted to ten.
The Xtreme Tiger Checo landed a foul blow the referee did not see and then a 450 splash.

matches.stipulation: Scramble Match for the YWA Heavyweight Championship
matches.finish: Pinfalls passed an interim title from Big Evil to Showtime Mr. PPV, to Lashley and to The Xtreme Tiger Checo; with the clock running out and Checo laid out by Criki's Sweet Chin Music from the crowd, he still held it at the bell and was named champion.
matches.note: The main event.

date.source: The results post is dated 16 June 2010.

evidence.note: The show of 16 June in play-by-play.
The card for this show, posted on 9 June.

matches.finish: Jericho hit a codebreaker on Midota M and covered him.
The Prince Phenomenal Mr. TNA tagged out and left; Tijuana Forever hit a Muscle Buster and El Aire de Tijuana covered The Phenomenal Mizard after a Shooting Star Press.
Lashley hit a Tombstone Piledriver and covered Omega Legend.
Asesino dodged El Juez's headbutt, hit a Twist of Fate and covered him to win the title.

date.source: The results post is dated 23 June 2010.

evidence.note: The show of 23 June in play-by-play.
The card for this show, posted on 16 June.

matches.finish: The Legend Killer Lashley hit a Tombstone Piledriver and covered Asesino, and became number one contender for the Heavyweight Championship at DESTRUCCION.
matches.note: Set up by the chairman from the Titantron: a win made Lashley the challenger, a loss barred him from any title while Asesino held his.

matches.stipulation: Tag Team Match por los YWA Alliance Tag Team Championships
matches.finish: Tijuana Forever hit a Muscle Buster on Luis15 and El Aire de Tijuana covered him after a Shooting Star Press; TWO are the new champions.

Lashley came in with a fire extinguisher and sprayed both men as they locked up, the referee ended it as a no contest, and Lashley then beat both with the extinguisher and Tombstone Piledrivers and took the Heavyweight Championship belt.
matches.note: The main event of the show.

date.source: The results post is dated 30 June 2010; its card was posted on 24 June.

evidence.note: The AWZ show of 30 June in play-by-play: the vacant heavyweight title, a battle royal, a contender match and the Beat The Clock tournament.
The card for this show, posted on 24 June.

matches.stipulation: Battle Royal Match for the YWA Y Division Championship
matches.finish: Dante threw Soplo toward ringside but Soplo clamped on a scissors hold and took Dante out with him; both fell at once, the General Manager called it a tie, left the title vacant and booked them one on one for DESTRUCCION.
matches.note: The Y Division Championship was vacant.

eliminations.note: Thrown to ringside after reversing a finishing lift.
Both fell to ringside in the same moment; the match was ruled a tie.

matches.stipulation: #1 Contender Match for the YWA Legend Champion
matches.finish: Mik Morrison hit a Moonlight Driver and covered The Bulldog Volcanic; he is the challenger to the Legend Champion at DESTRUCCION.
Luis15 hit a Styles Clash and covered The Best Austin in 5:54, the first time to beat.
Tijuana Forever hit a Mistica after El Juez missed his headbutt and El Juez gave up, in 5:40, to take first place.
Lashley caught X-treme Angel's moonsault and hit a Tombstone Piledriver, in 4:23, to take first place.
matches.note: Lashley had attacked X-treme Angel with a chair on the way to the ring; the General Manager had told him that winning the clock would let him choose his own opponent for the pay-per-view.

matches.finish: El Aire de Tijuana had Jericho down after an Asian Moonsault and the referee was counting when the clock ran out; Luis15 then attacked El Aire de Tijuana, Jericho joined in, the two floored the TWO and Luis15 demanded a tag title rematch at the pay-per-view.
matches.note: Time to beat: 4:23.

matches.finish: RateDX rolled in at the count of ten, with Criki late, and won by count out in 4:22, beating Lashley's time of 4:23 to become the challenger.
matches.note: The main event of the show.

date.source: The general manager's report is posted on 7 July 2010 and gives no other date; the pay-per-view is dated by that post.

evidence.note: The report on the pay-per-view: five matches, a backstage attack and a recap of the four weeks before it.
The card of 24 June names the Legend contender match and the Beat The Clock tournament that fed this show.

matches.finish: Dante hit a spear and covered Soplo to become the first Y Division Champion.
matches.note: The two had tied the battle royal for the vacant title on 30 June.

matches.finish: The Prince Mr Phenomenal TNA left the ring saying Criki was not worth his time and was counted out.
Mik Morrison hit a Capoeira Kick and a Starship Pain from the corner and covered Asesino to win the title.

matches.stipulation: YWA Alliance Tag Team Championship Match
matches.finish: El Aire de Tijuana hit a Kryptonite Krunch on Jericho and covered him; the TWO kept the belts, and Luis15 then hit Jericho with a Styles Clash.

RateDX, hurt backstage, did not come out and the General Manager put Criki in his place; Lashley threw the referee into Criki, RateDX arrived to Angle Slam both men, and Lashley covered Criki with a replacement referee counting.
matches.note: The main event. The match had been announced as Lashley against RateDX for the vacant heavyweight title.

date.source: The results post is dated 14 July 2010.

evidence.note: The AWZ show after DESTRUCCION: a recap of its main event, four qualifiers for the MASACRE tournament and two tag matches.

matches.stipulation: Lucha Clasificatoria al torneo de Masacres
matches.finish: El Millonario de Tijuana hit a Corkscrew Senton and covered X-treme Angel to qualify.

matches.stipulation: Lucha Clasificatoria al torneo de Masacres
matches.finish: Coke hit a Zig Zag and covered Super Kane to qualify.

matches.stipulation: Lucha Clasificatoria al torneo de Masacres
matches.finish: Asesino offered his hand, the Prince hit him instead and finished him with a Burning Hammer to qualify.

matches.stipulation: Lucha Clasificatoria al torneo de Masacres
matches.finish: Luis15 hit a Styles Clash and covered Soplo to qualify.
Dante hit a spear on Tijuana Forever as he ran in and covered him; afterwards Dante speared his own partner three times.
matches.note: Mik Morrison had broken up El Aire de Tijuana's cover on Dante, and El Aire de Tijuana had thrown Mik Morrison onto Dante in turn.

matches.finish: RateDX put an angle lock on The Xtreme Tiger Checo and he gave up.
matches.note: The main event. The General Manager then named both RateDX and Criki challengers to Lashley for the heavyweight title at MASACRE, in a Stretcher Match.

date.source: The results post is dated 21 July 2010; its card was posted on 14 July.

evidence.note: The AWZ show of 21 July in play-by-play: promos by the eight tournament entrants and four matches.
The card for this show, posted on 14 July.

matches.finish: RateDX hit a Hurricanrana and an angle lock; Super Kane gave up and RateDX kept the hold on after the bell.

Both men were counted out; Soplo then took a chair, climbed a corner and hit Jericho with a Skullcrusher, knocking both out, and the General Manager made the pair fight for the YWA Extreme Championship at MASACRE.
RateDX hit Criki with a chair and threw him into a monitor; Lashley, who had been through a table, crawled over and covered him.
matches.note: Criki challenged Lashley to the match in the ring.

matches.finish: Tijuana Forever hit a Muscle Buster on Luis15, the last other man in the ring, and threw him to ringside; he pointed at the MASACRE logo.
matches.note: The main event. The order of elimination seeds the first round of the MASACRE tournament.

eliminations.note: Thrown over the top rope with Tijuana Forever hanging on.
Pulled over the top rope by Luis15's legs around his head.

date.source: The results post is dated 27 July 2010.

evidence.note: The AWZ show of 27 July: a challenge between the champion and El Aire de Tijuana and four matches before MASACRE.

matches.finish: The Prince left the ring to walk out; Mik Morrison chased him, hit him from behind with a sledge hammer (a double axe handle), brought him back in and covered him after a Starship Pain.
Dante hit an ElectroCutter and covered Luis15, then helped him up and shook his hand.
RateDX hit a German suplex and an angle lock on Soplo and he gave up; RateDX then Angle Slammed Jericho.

Lashley slammed El Aire de Tijuana into all four corners, hit a front powerslam and put on his Sharpshooter, and El Aire de Tijuana gave up; RateDX then Angle Slammed Lashley three times and Criki hit RateDX with a Sweet Chin Music and held up the title.
matches.note: The main event.

date.source: The general manager's report is posted on 6 August 2010 and gives no other date; the pay-per-view is dated by that post.

evidence.note: The report on the pay-per-view: the Masacres tournament from its first round to the steel-cage final, the Extreme Championship match and the stretcher match.
The column of 9 July sets out the tournament's rounds.

matches.finish: Tijuana Forever hit a Muscle Buster on Coke on a chair in the middle of the ring and covered him.
matches.note: First round, shown on YWA.COM. The match was booked as Coke against El Aire de Tijuana; Coke hurt El Aire's leg with a chair before it and Tijuana Forever took his place.

matches.finish: Luis15 hit El Millonario de Tijuana's arm with a kendo stick until he gave up.
matches.note: First round, shown on YWA.COM.

matches.finish: Mik Morrison pulled the pad off a corner, threw Dante into it and hit a Starship Pain.
matches.note: First round, shown on YWA.COM.

matches.finish: Dante hit an Electrocutter and buried the Prince in the thumbtacks.
matches.note: First round, shown on YWA.COM. The heading names Tijuana Forever (who had taken El Aire de Tijuana's place in the Chair Match) as the Prince's opponent, but the account that follows makes it Dante: the Prince was about to go through unopposed when Dante, beaten in his first match, asked for another and the General Manager agreed.

matches.stipulation: Parking Lot Brawl con Last Ride Match
matches.finish: After a chase in a hearse and a limousine outside the arena, Tijuana Forever put Luis15 in the hearse and shut the door.
matches.note: Semifinal of the Masacres tournament.

matches.stipulation: Extreme Rules Match por el YWA Extreme Championship
matches.finish: Soplo tried to suplex Jericho onto thumbtacks from the steel steps; Jericho broke free with a codebreaker, Soplo fell on the thumbtacks and Jericho covered him to win the revived Extreme Championship.

matches.stipulation: Parking Lot Brawl con Last Ride Match
matches.finish: Mik Morrison hit Dante with a pipe, put him in the hearse and drove it out of the car park.
matches.note: Semifinal of the Masacres tournament.

matches.stipulation: Strecher Match por el YWA World Heavyweight Championship
matches.finish: Criki handcuffed RateDX to a stretcher; Lashley hit Criki with a Tombstone Piledriver on the steel ramp, laid him on a second stretcher and pushed him over the finish line while RateDX could not get free.
matches.note: Lashley was the champion. Submissions did not count: Lashley gave up to Criki's crossface and Criki to RateDX's angle lock without effect.

matches.stipulation: Final del Torneo de Masacres en Ladder, Steel Cage con Strap Match
matches.finish: Tijuana Forever missed a Shooting Star Press through the announcers' table; Mik Morrison cut the rope with pliers, took a ladder from under the ring back in (the four in the ring were broken), climbed it and unhooked the briefcase while Tijuana Forever lay knocked out.
matches.note: The main event. The winner became the challenger for the heavyweight title at SUPREMACIA DE UN CAMPEON; the two were tied by a three-metre rope.
